title: array_search returns the type of key
summary: array_search returns the first matching key. The integer key 0 and false if the search fails need to be distinguished by ===.
detail: The third parameter true requires both value and type to match. Searching for the string "7" may hit different slots than searching for the integer 7.
boundary: When the same value appears multiple times, a single search will only give the first match.
relevance: When restoring the mapping table selection results, the zeroth hit item can easily be regarded as missing.
